title: Gamorrean Guard
description: Faithfully guarding Jabba's Palace, the Gamorrean Guards were the sentinels that kept the rabble away from Jabba at all hours of day and night. After Jabba's tragic passing, the Gamorrean Guards committed their loyalty to his natural successor, Bib Fortuna—but that was where they drew the line. When Boba Fett assassinated Fortuna, they refused to surrender. Fett gave them a final chance, though, and they traded their lives for a renewed loyalty to him. They remained steadfast until their dying breaths.
